description: Sprint 10 E2E test ACLs. Differentiated per-folder groups so security trimming returns different results per group. Paths include the 'testset' segment because the Fabric shortcut Files/s3_mmx_bucket points at the bucket root and test docs live under testset/. Resolution is nearest-ancestor: a subfolder entry overrides its parent. engineering/* is intentionally omitted to exercise the no_acl skip path. Group GUIDs are placeholders for Entra group object IDs the calling app injects per user. See PRODUCT_SPEC.md section 10 and the Sprint 10 E2E section.
